priority_in_source: High, once prices exist. Until then use log-loss and Brier.

risk_if_deferred: The 'publish twice until one wins' rule turns into a coin flip that someone later calls evidence

recommended_by_source: Print HFA estimate + its bootstrap interval in the model page header and in every fair-line row.
risk_if_deferred: Assumptions that were never tested keep propagating into new features

options_raised: Path A: keep COORDINATION.md as the board and move history to COORDINATION_HISTORY.md. Path B: one file per session in a directory. Path C: leave as is.
recommended_by_source: Path A - board stays at the top of COORDINATION.md; older sections move to an archive file.
effort: Low - reversible, but it is a shared file

theme_name: Coordination, ownership and merge process
suggestion: Stop concurrent branches editing the same derived inventories
problem_it_solves: Every integration session must resolve the same conflicts in generated files, and a stale hash can fail CI for unrelated reasons.
options_raised: Path A: mark generated inventories as build artifacts and exclude them from PR diffs. Path B: regenerate only in the final integration run. Path C: leave as is.
recommended_by_source: Path B - regenerate derived inventories only in the final integration, never in a feature branch.

theme_name: Coordination, ownership and merge process
suggestion: Stop shipping new per-session dashboards that re-answer the same question
problem_it_solves: Ten packs publish the same four tables from the same four pages with different labels. The marginal decision value of pack eleven is close to zero; the marginal confusion is not.
recommended_by_source: Declare one canonical pack, link the others as archive, and make new sessions extend the canonical tables instead of cloning them.
risk_if_deferred: The site becomes the thing that needs verifying instead of the thing that supports decisions

theme_name: Coordination, ownership and merge process
suggestion: Ask the shared session that owns scripts/source_coverage.py to add the NFL domains
problem_it_solves: NFL.com rows are currently reported as secondary_reference_only because the publisher list has no NFL entry, which understates the provenance of every row in this pack.
recommended_by_source: Log a cross-session request in COORDINATION.md rather than editing the shared file.
priority_in_source: Low effort, affects how this pack is audited.

theme_name: Coordination, ownership and merge process
suggestion: Fix or Formally Quarantine Legacy `scripts/model.py` (`A-F02`) and Dead External Links (`docs/sf-rent/`)
problem_it_solves: Prevents downstream scripts or reviewers from accidentally importing unverified ESPN-quoted CSVs or clicking dead 404 URLs
options_raised: Path A: Move unverified prototype CSVs to `data/legacy_quarantine/` with README warning and update dead 404 links; Path B: Keep paths frozen for hash stability and add warning badges
recommended_by_source: Path B while frozen hash checks in `audit_sources.py` (`BASE=77a28cc`) depend on exact legacy paths

theme_name: Coordination, ownership and merge process
suggestion: Keep the NFL pack in its own directory and link it from the shared index rather than merging it into an existing dashboard.
problem_it_solves: Concurrent sessions edit the same shared pages; merging would cause conflicting edits.
risk_if_deferred: A separate directory can stagnate if nobody links it.

theme_name: Fixture context: venue, roof, weather, rest, internationals
suggestion: Transcribe venue, roof and surface for every fixture
problem_it_solves: Builds the fixture-context feature set and the stadium overlay join.
options_raised: A: venue for all weeks, roof/surface where published. B: venue only. C: skip.
effort: Totals and passing props stay exposed to stadium effects.

theme_name: Fixture context: venue, roof, weather, rest, internationals
suggestion: Record the first prospective forecast before Week 11 kickoff
problem_it_solves: Starts the only record that can ever clear G8.
options_raised: A: freeze a model version and record Week 11. B: wait for the depth source. C: wait for prices.
effort: The prospective record stays at zero and nothing can ever qualify.

theme_name: Fixture context: venue, roof, weather, rest, internationals
suggestion: Add a per-team rest column from an official source.
options_raised: A: leave it uncomputable. B: derive it from official game dates with Thursday/Monday handled explicitly. C: find a publisher that states rest days.
recommended_by_source: B, labelled derived_not_verified.
risk_if_deferred: Derivation is an inference, so it cannot be labelled verified; it would have to carry its own status.

theme_name: Fixture context: venue, roof, weather, rest, internationals
suggestion: Add Public-Domain NOAA/NWS & DWD Kickoff Weather Feed for Outdoor NFL Stadiums
problem_it_solves: Outdoor wind >= 15 mph and precipitation strongly shift NFL totals FG range and QB/WR vs RB volume correlations—and U.S. NWS API is 100% public domain (no license fee!)
options_raised: Path A: Offline pre-slate script pulling `api.weather.gov` gridpoints for the 32 NFL stadium coordinates; Path B: Manual roof/wind CSV log
recommended_by_source: Path A (free official U.S. government `weather.gov` source with zero copyright/licensing barrier)

theme_name: Combos: parlays, SGP and player props
suggestion: Treat the player-prop family as blocked, not deferred
problem_it_solves: No official NFL page publishes prop lines. Registering the family without a data route invites someone to fill it in later with non-official numbers.
recommended_by_source: Keep A9-S10 in the leaderboard with a blocked status until a data route exists, and re-open only when nextgenstats or a licensed feed is available.

theme_name: Combos: parlays, SGP and player props
suggestion: Unblocks D966-STR-10 and correlation candidate D966-CX-02: a prop leg could be settled from a box score, and a prop-team parlay could be priced with a measured dependence instead of an assumption.
problem_it_solves: the parlay machinery (legs, push handling, joint probability from a measured rho) is already written; only the axis is missing
effort: a box-score ingest per game plus a player-id join against the injury report
risk_if_deferred: player-name joins are where misattribution happens; a wrong join settles a leg wrong, so the id join needs its own identity check

theme_name: Combos: parlays, SGP and player props
suggestion: Show 'Sportsbook Implicit Correlation Tax' Column Before Allowing Any Combo Evaluation
problem_it_solves: Prevents betting positively correlated SGPs (e.g. QB Pass Over + WR1 Rec Over) where sportsbook SGP pricing already overcharges beyond the copula lift
options_raised: Path A: Mandatory 3-number display (`Indep_Fair_Odds` | `Copula_Correlated_Fair_Odds` | `Book_Quoted_Odds_&_Tax`); Path B: Hard-block SGPs with >8% implicit hold
recommended_by_source: Path A + Path B combined
effort: Medium effort · High protection against SGP hold traps

theme_name: Combos: parlays, SGP and player props
suggestion: Register the *sign* of each dependence before measuring it, and treat a sign error as a failed gate.
problem_it_solves: A correlation computed after seeing the data can always be explained.
risk_if_deferred: Some pairs will turn out to have no measurable dependence, which invalidates the combo built on them.
